title: Message Channel Decision Tree
description: Two questions decide whether a message goes to the group chat, to email, or either.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

educational.audience: Mentors and club leaders sending messages

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a message's urgency and audience, the learner determines which communication channel is appropriate.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin two-question decision tree with three outcomes
pedagogical.assessment: Give three messages of differing urgency and ask which channel each takes.
